name: hermes-agent-acp
description: ACP v1 adapter for Hermes Agent, built on the Hermes tui_gateway

scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && RUN_HERMES_E2E=true vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/__tests__/e2e
scripts.package: bun run build && cp dist/index.js dist/hermes-agent-acp && chmod +x dist/hermes-agent-acp && rm -f dist/hermes-agent-acp.zip && zip -j dist/hermes-agent-acp.zip dist/hermes-agent-acp LICENSE NOTICE
